learningObjectives: Apply CSS selectors, properties, and the box model.
Construct layouts using Flexbox and responsive techniques.
Choose appropriate styling strategies for different screen sizes.

activities.title: CSS Rule Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the selector, property, value, and declaration of a CSS rule.

content.concept: A CSS rule uses a selector to target elements and declarations to define their visual properties.

activities.title: Box Model Explorer
activities.instruction: Adjust spacing layers and observe how they change the element's size.

content.concept: The CSS box model consists of content, padding, border, and margin, each affecting layout differently.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Flexbox Layout Builder
activities.instruction: Configure a Flexbox container to align and distribute its children.

content.concept: Flexbox provides properties such as display, flex-direction, justify-content, align-items, and gap for arranging elements.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Responsive Strategy
activities.instruction: Choose the styling approach that best adapts a layout across screen sizes.

content.concept: Responsive design combines flexible layouts, relative sizing, and media queries to adapt interfaces to different viewport sizes.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Use flexible layouts with appropriate breakpoints
Create a separate page for every screen width
config.answer: Use flexible layouts with appropriate breakpoints
